records.text: Subscription revenue increased by $22.7 million and $67.7 million during the three and nine months ended April 30, 2023, respectively, compared to the same periods a year ago, primarily due to the impact of cloud transition agreements, the renewal or extension of subscription services at the fully ramped annual fees after the initial committed term, and new subscription agreements entered into and provisioned since April 30, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have experienced seasonal variations in our license revenue and, to a lesser extent, in our subscription revenue as a result of increased customer orders in our fourth fiscal quarter.

records.text: The success of our sales efforts relies on continued improvements and enhancements to our current services and products, the introduction of new services and products, efficient operation of our cloud infrastructure, continued development of relevant local content and automated tools for updating content, and successful implementations and migrations.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Revenue: For the three months ended April 30, 2023, revenue was $8.2 billion, an increase of 11 percent year-over-year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in subscription and support revenues for the three months ended April 30, 2023 was primarily caused by volume-driven increases from new business, which includes new customers, upgrades and additional subscriptions from existing customers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Remaining Performance Obligation: Total remaining performance obligation as of April 30, 2023 was approximately $46.7 billion, an increase of 11 percent year-over-year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended April 30, 2023, the increase in cost of revenues in absolute dollars was primarily due to an increase in employee-related costs, including stock-based compensation expense.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Cash: Cash provided by operations for the three months ended April 30, 2023 was $4.5 billion, an increase of 22 percent year-over-year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales from the Retail segment accounted for approximately 90.2% of consolidated net sales for the three months ended April 30, 2023, compared to 91.6% for the comparable period in fiscal 2023.
